text_markup: The Runner plays {card:Because I Can}, which directs them to make a run on a remote server. If an effect moves the run to a central server, the "If successful" effect on {card:Because I Can} will not apply. However, if the run is moved instead to another remote server, the "If successful" effect is still applied, since {card:Because I Can} would have allowed a run on the second remote server to begin with.
text_plain: The Runner plays Because I Can, which directs them to make a run on a remote server. If an effect moves the run to a central server, the "If successful" effect on Because I Can will not apply. However, if the run is moved instead to another remote server, the "If successful" effect is still applied, since Because I Can would have allowed a run on the second remote server to begin with.
